Raw source files for MentalScape 2.0, collected automatically by the `Ingest MHSDS` workflow.

Each asset is a file published by NHS England in the Mental Health Services Monthly Statistics, stored exactly as downloaded. CSV files are gzipped. Asset names follow the pattern `mhsds__kind__month__version__revision__checksum`. `manifest.csv` lists every asset with its source URL, original file name, checksums and download date. `catalogue.csv` lists every file found on the release pages, including the ones the pipeline does not collect, with the reason.

Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source NHS England, Mental Health Services Monthly Statistics, https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/publications/statistical/mental-health-services-monthly-statistics

These are published aggregate statistics. No patient level data is held.
